legend.culture.accOsmNote: Community-mapped coverage, not a complete or official register. © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
legend.culture.accDensityNote: Counts only the 25,459 mappable accommodation records (canonical set); OSM coverage is not overlaid, and 502 records without geometry are not placed in any cell.
legend.culture.sportsNoteSize: Size = area (log scale; fixed size when missing)
legend.culture.sportsNoteLayers: Belongs to 5 groups: school / other public / private / sports park / civil sports center (each toggled separately)
legend.culture.sportsNoteClosed: ⚠️ Venues not open to the public are faded (semi-transparent)
legend.culture.libNote: Aggregated from 6 branches · data refreshed every 10 minutes
legend.culture.religionUnmarkedNote: Almost all of the 6,855 "Not specified" records are folk shrines outside the registration system (switch to "Registered" to see only the officially registered version)
legend.culture.funeralApproxNote: 42% of points use approximate coordinates (parcel or township centroids; the popup says so) — switch to "Precise locations only" for distance analysis
legend.culture.funeralOpNote: By default only the 4,569 operators still in business are drawn (another 1,664 are inactive — closed, revoked, dissolved, or moved to another county/city)
legend.culture.funeralZoningNote: Only Taipei (12) + New Taipei (102) polygons — blanks in the other 20 counties/cities are expected (urban-plan zoning has been done for these two only)
legend.culture.funeralBothNote: The two layers mean different things: green = actual cemetery areas mapped in OSM, brown = land legally designated under urban planning. They are deliberately not merged; the difference itself is information.
legend.culture.funeralDensityNote: Counts operators by registered address, not service coverage — operators often serve other districts
legend.culture.jpReligionNote: Japan has no official nationwide religious-facility layer. No single layer is complete, and the three layers' counts should not be added up. Checked against the Osaka Prefecture register, GSI matched only 62% and the union of all three sources still misses 25.9%. Turn on one source at a time.
legend.culture.jpReligionGsi: Source: Geospatial Information Authority of Japan (GSI) optimal vector tiles
